description: Execute any discovered GitLab platform action with input validation and token-optimized response projection. Dispatches directly to the corresponding API endpoint while enforcing read-only safety restrictions.

action.description: The exact GitLab action name to execute (e.g. 'create_merge_request', 'list_pipelines', 'trigger_push_mirror_sync')

format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, token-optimized compact table/text for LLM) or 'json' (structured JSON)

parameters.description: Key-value parameters for the designated action (as discovered from gitlab_find_actions)

name: gitlab_execute_action
title: Execute GitLab Action
